in_hebrew.name: Willetta
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Willetta הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Old German name Wilhelmina, meaning 'resolute protector'. This name was borne by St. Wilgefortis, a legendary martyr who was said to have been miraculously saved from her pagan father's plans to marry her off to an idol. She was later tortured and killed for her faith, becoming a patron saint of the impossible and difficult situations.
